dataset_name: Incredible Journeys: Discover India Knowledge Graph

provenance_and_zero_hallucination_policy.unverified_candidates_handling: Seed rows treated as unverified candidates; canonical title, coordinates, and region verified against Wikimedia APIs.
provenance_and_zero_hallucination_policy.missing_data_treatment: Missing or unconfirmed attributes (coordinates, exact entry fees, timings) are explicitly maintained as null or empty, never fabricated.
provenance_and_zero_hallucination_policy.rag_attribution_requirement: All retrieved passages injected into LLM context retain source URL, license string, and title attribution.
